# Reviewed configuration options

This reference covers the options audited in project-analysis item P1-02.
Deprecated options are accepted for one compatibility cycle, emit a warning,
and have no runtime effect.

| Environment | YAML path | Default | Validation | Status | Description / migration |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `WEB_UI_REFRESH_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `web_ui.refresh_interval_seconds` | `5` | integer >= 1 | active | Polling interval of the overview page in seconds. |
| `OBS_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `observability.heartbeat_interval_seconds` | `30` | deprecated; value is ignored | deprecated | Reserved option that never controlled a runtime heartbeat. Use the health endpoints and SMARTTUB_POLLING_INTERVAL_SECONDS. |
| `OBS_TELEMETRY_BATCH_SIZE` | `observability.telemetry_batch_size` | `10` | deprecated; value is ignored | deprecated | Reserved option that never controlled telemetry batching. No replacement; MQTT state publishing is not batch based. |
| `SAFETY_FAIL_SAFE_MODE` | `safety.fail_safe_mode` | `stop_pumps` | deprecated; value is ignored | deprecated | Never activated an automatic fail-safe action. No replacement; the bridge does not issue unrequested commands. |
| `SAFETY_POST_COMMAND_WAIT_SECONDS` | `safety.post_command_wait_seconds` | `12` | deprecated; value is ignored | deprecated | Never controlled the command state refresh delay. Use STATE_UPDATE_DELAY_SECONDS. |
| `SAFETY_COMMAND_VERIFICATION_RETRIES` | `safety.command_verification_retries` | `3` | deprecated; value is ignored | deprecated | Never enabled command verification retries. No replacement; inspect the command result and observed state. |
| `SAFETY_COMMAND_MAX_RETRIES` | `safety.command_max_retries` | `2` | deprecated; value is ignored | deprecated | Never controlled command retries. No replacement; commands are not retried automatically. |
| `DISCOVERY_REFRESH_INTERVAL` | `capability.discovery_refresh_interval` | `3600` | deprecated; value is ignored | deprecated | Never scheduled periodic invasive discovery. Use DISCOVERY_MODE for startup discovery or start it manually. |
| `CAPABILITY_ENABLE_AUTO_DISCOVERY` | `capability.enable_auto_discovery` | `true` | deprecated; value is ignored | deprecated | Never enabled automatic discovery. Use DISCOVERY_MODE=off|startup_quick|startup_full|startup_yaml. |
